name: WhirlwindTeleportingState
summary: $0522 0 none, 1 whirlwind carrying Link away, 2 dropping him off.

name: TeleportingLevelIndex
summary: $0523 Whirlwind destination: (value & 7) = level number - 1.

name: SpawnCycle
summary: $0524 Next index 0-8 into the 9-entry spawn position list; kept between rooms.

name: CurEdgeSpawnCell
summary: $0525 Last screen-edge spawn cell: high nibble = row, low nibble = column.

name: LevelEntranceRoomId
summary: $0526 Overworld room of the dungeon entrance last entered; $FF = none.

name: CellarSourceRoomId
summary: $0527 Dungeon room from which the current cellar was entered.

name: HasSkippedDemo
summary: $0528 $5A once Start was pressed in the title demo; stops the demo animation.

name: IsSwordShotForced
summary: $0529 Nonzero would allow the sword shot at any health. Only ever cleared.

name: WorldKillCycle
summary: $052A Kill cycle 0-9: column of the drop table used for the next drop.

name: RoomTileObjType
summary: $052B Object type of the room's tile object found by the layout, 0 = none.

name: RoomTileObjX
summary: $052C X of that tile object (column * $10).

name: RoomTileObjY
summary: $052D Y of that tile object (row * $10 + $40).

name: IsSwordBlocked
summary: $052E 1 = sword disabled until cured (set by Bubble type $2D, cleared by $2C).

name: MazeStep
summary: $052F Correct steps so far (0-3) in the Lost Woods ($61) or Lost Hills ($1B).

name: PlayAreaAttrs
summary: $0530 [48] Nametable attribute bytes of the play area (from attrs A and B).

name: LevelKillCounts
summary: $0560 [128] per room of the current dungeon: kills banked when leaving it.

name: CurNoteLowPeriodTrg
summary: $05F0 Low period byte of the triangle note playing (base for vibrato).

name: SampleCounter
summary: $05F2 Frames left of the DMC sample ($A0 at start).

name: SeaSfxCounter
summary: $05F3 Sea noise effect phase counter, counts down from $D0.

name: NoteLengthTableBase
summary: $05F4 Song phrase: base offset into the note length table.

name: FirstNoteIndexSongNoise
summary: $05F5 Song phrase: script offset where the noise track starts (it loops).

name: BackgroundSample
summary: $05F6 Looping DMC sample (request bits $F0), restarted when no other plays.

name: SongRequest
summary: $0600 Song to start (one bit): $01 overworld, $08 item, $10 ending,

name: SampleRequest
summary: $0601 DMC sample to start (bit mask; bits $F0 loop). PlaySample ORs into it.

name: Tune1Request
summary: $0602 Square-1 tune to start (bit mask; $80 = silence first).

name: EffectRequest
summary: $0603 Noise effect to start (bit mask). PlayEffect ORs into it.

name: Tune0Request
summary: $0604 Square-0 tune to start (bit mask; $40 low-hearts beep, $80 stops song).

name: CurTune0
summary: $0605 Square-0 tune playing (its request bit), 0 = none.

name: CurEffect
summary: $0606 Noise effect playing, 0 = none.

name: CurTune1
summary: $0607 Square-1 tune playing, 0 = none; the song skips square 1 meanwhile.

name: CurSample
summary: $0608 DMC sample playing, 0 = none.

name: CurSong
summary: $0609 Song playing (its request bit), 0 = none.

name: NoteOffsetSongSq1
summary: $060A Song script offset of the next square-1 note.

name: NoteOffsetSongSq0
summary: $060B Song script offset of the next square-0 note (0 = track absent).

name: NoteOffsetSongTrg
summary: $060C Song script offset of the next triangle note (0 = track absent).

name: NoteOffsetSongNoise
summary: $060D Song script offset of the next noise note.

name: Tune0ScriptOffset
summary: $060E Offset of the next byte of the square-0 tune in TuneScripts0.

name: NoteLengthSongSq0
summary: $060F Length in frames of the current square-0 song note.

name: NoteLengthSongSq1
summary: $0610 Length in frames of the current square-1 song note.

name: NoteCounterSongSq1
summary: $0611 Frames left of the current square-1 song note.

name: CustomEnvelopeOffsetSongSq1
summary: $0612 Square-1 volume envelope position, counts down to 0.

name: NoteCounterSongSq0
summary: $0613 Frames left of the current square-0 song note.

name: CustomEnvelopeOffsetSongSq0
summary: $0614 Square-0 volume envelope position, counts down to 0.

name: NoteLengthSongTrg
summary: $0615 Length in frames of the current triangle song note.

name: NoteCounterSongTrg
summary: $0616 Frames left of the current triangle song note.

name: NoteCounterSongNoise
summary: $0617 Frames left of the current noise song note.

name: Tune1ScriptOffset
summary: $0618 Offset of the next byte of the square-1 tune in TuneScripts1.

name: SongEnvelopeSelector
summary: $0619 Song phrase: volume envelope selector (byte 6 of the phrase header).

name: SongVibrationCounterSq1
summary: $061B Frames since the square-1 song note began (vibrato phase).

name: SongVibrationCounterSq0
summary: $061C Frames since the square-0 song note began (vibrato phase).

name: SongVibrationCounterTrg
summary: $061D Frames since the triangle song note began (vibrato phase).

name: SongRepetitionsTrg
summary: $061E Triangle track: repetitions left of the passage being repeated.

name: SongRepeatStartOffset
summary: $061F Triangle track: script offset where the repeated passage starts.

name: CurRoomHistoryIndex
summary: $0620 Slot 0-5 of RoomHistory that the next new room overwrites.

name: RoomHistory
summary: $0621 [6] Ids of the last six different rooms entered (ring buffer).

name: WorldKillCount
summary: $0627 Monsters killed since Link was last harmed (zeroed by Link_BeHarmed).

name: QuestNumbers
summary: $062D [3] per save slot: 0 = Q1, 1 = Q2. Read in play through CurSaveSlot.

name: DeathCounts
summary: $0630 [3] per save slot: deaths, stops at $FF.

name: IsSaveSlotActive
summary: $0633 [3] per save slot: nonzero = registered. The menu reads 5 entries.

name: IsRegisterSaveFileOptionEnabled
summary: $0636 IsSaveSlotActive[3], the menu's Register option: always 1.

name: IsEliminateSaveFileOptionEnabled
summary: $0637 IsSaveSlotActive[4], the menu's Eliminate option: always 1.

name: SaveSlotNames
summary: $0638 [24] 3 slots x 8 characters: the slot names (tile codes, $24 = space).

name: SaveSlotHearts
summary: $0650 [6] 3 slots x (HeartValues, HeartPartial) shown on the file menu.

name: SelectedItemSlot
summary: $0656 Item slot on the B button: 0 boomerangs, 1-8 = InvItems+n, $F letter.

name: InvItems
summary: $0657 [40] Base of the items block, indexed by item slot. InvItems+0 = sword.

name: InvSword
summary: $0657 Sword: 0 none, 1 wooden, 2 white, 3 magic. Same byte as InvItems.

name: InvBombs
summary: $0658 Bombs held, 0 to InvMaxBombs. A bomb pickup adds 4.

name: InvArrow
summary: $0659 Arrows: 0 none, 1 wooden (damage $20), 2 silver (damage $40).

name: InvBow
summary: $065A Bow: 0 or 1. Arrows cannot be selected or shot without it.

name: InvCandle
summary: $065B Candle: 0 none, 1 blue (one fire per room), 2 red.

name: InvFlute
summary: $065C Flute: 0 or 1. The code reaches this byte only by index (InvItems, Y).

name: InvFood
summary: $065D Food: 0 or 1. Zeroed when the Grumble Goriya takes it.

name: InvPotion
summary: $065E Potion doses 0-2. Blue potion adds 1 (max 2), red sets 2; a use takes 1.

name: InvRod
summary: $065F Magic rod: 0 or 1. The code reaches this byte only by index (InvItems,Y).

name: InvRaft
summary: $0660 Raft: 0 or 1.

name: InvBook
summary: $0661 Magic book: 0 or 1. With it a magic shot that ends makes a fire.

name: InvRing
summary: $0662 Ring: 0 none, 1 blue, 2 red. Damage to Link is halved once per grade.

name: InvLadder
summary: $0663 Ladder: 0 or 1.

name: InvMagicKey
summary: $0664 Magic key: 0 or 1. Opens locked doors without spending InvKeys.

name: InvBracelet
summary: $0665 Power bracelet: 0 or 1. Needed to push a rock ($62), not a gravestone.

name: InvLetter
summary: $0666 Letter: 0 none, 1 held, 2 shown to the cave person of type $74.

name: InvCompass
summary: $0667 Compasses of levels 1-8: bit (level - 1). Reached only by index ($10).

name: InvMap
summary: $0668 Maps of levels 1-8: bit (level - 1). Reached only by index (slot $11).

name: InvCompass9
summary: $0669 Compass of level 9: bit 0. Reached only by index (slot $12).

name: InvMap9
summary: $066A Map of level 9: bit 0. Reached only by index (slot $13).

name: InvFairy
summary: $066B Slot $14 of the fairy item (id $23). Never written: a fairy only heals.

name: InvClock
summary: $066C Clock: 1 = monsters frozen, Link invincible. Zeroed on every room change

name: InvRupees
summary: $066D Rupees, 0-$FF. Changes by 1 via InvRupeesToAdd / InvRupeesToSubtract.

name: InvKeys
summary: $066E Keys, 0-$FF.

name: HeartValues
summary: $066F High nibble = heart containers - 1; low nibble = full hearts.

name: HeartPartial
summary: $0670 Partial heart fill: 0 empty, $01-$7F drawn half, $80-$FF drawn full.

name: InvTriforce
summary: $0671 Triforce pieces: bit (level - 1) for levels 1-8; $FF = all eight.

name: InvPowerTriforce
summary: $0672 Slot $1B, Triforce of Power: 1 once its fanfare ends. Opens the shutters

name: InvFiveRupees
summary: $0673 Slot $1C of the 5-rupee item (id $0F). Never written: 5 x TakeOneRupee.

name: InvBoomerang
summary: $0674 Wooden boomerang: 0 or 1.

name: InvMagicBoomerang
summary: $0675 Magic boomerang: 0 or 1. Sets the throw's range limit to $FF, else $31.

name: InvMagicShield
summary: $0676 Magic shield: 0 or 1. Zeroed when a Like-Like eats it.

name: InvMaxBombs
summary: $067C Bomb capacity: 8 in a new file, +4 per upgrade bought (100 rupees).

name: InvRupeesToAdd
summary: $067D Rupees still to be credited to InvRupees, 1 every second frame.

name: InvRupeesToSubtract
summary: $067E Rupees still to be taken from InvRupees, 1 every second frame.

name: WorldFlags
summary: $067F [384] One flag byte per room: $67F overworld, $6FF levels 1-6, $77F 7-9.

name: PpuControl
summary: $2000 PPU control register (write).

name: PpuMask
summary: $2001 PPU mask register (write).

name: PpuStatus
summary: $2002 PPU status register (read; reading resets the address latch).

name: OamAddr
summary: $2003 OAM address (write).

name: OamData
summary: $2004 OAM data. Not used by the code.

name: PpuScroll
summary: $2005 PPU scroll (two writes: X, Y).

name: PpuAddr
summary: $2006 PPU VRAM address (two writes: high, low).

name: PpuData
summary: $2007 PPU VRAM data.

name: Sq0Duty
summary: $4000 Square 0: duty, envelope, volume.

name: Sq0Sweep
summary: $4001 Square 0: sweep.

name: Sq0Timer
summary: $4002 Square 0: period low byte.

name: Sq0Length
summary: $4003 Square 0: length counter, period high bits.

name: Sq1Duty
summary: $4004 Square 1: duty, envelope, volume.

name: Sq1Sweep
summary: $4005 Square 1: sweep.

name: Sq1Timer
summary: $4006 Square 1: period low byte.

name: Sq1Length
summary: $4007 Square 1: length counter, period high bits.

name: TrgLinear
summary: $4008 Triangle: linear counter.

name: TrgTimer
summary: $400A Triangle: period low byte.

name: TrgLength
summary: $400B Triangle: length counter, period high bits.

name: NoiseVolume
summary: $400C Noise: envelope, volume.

name: NoisePeriod
summary: $400E Noise: mode and period.

name: NoiseLength
summary: $400F Noise: length counter.

name: DmcFreq
summary: $4010 DMC: flags and rate.

name: DmcCounter
summary: $4011 DMC: output level.

name: DmcAddress
summary: $4012 DMC: sample address.

name: DmcLength
summary: $4013 DMC: sample length.

name: SpriteDma
summary: $4014 OAM DMA: page number of the sprite buffer to copy.

name: ApuStatus
summary: $4015 APU channel enables.

name: Ctrl1
summary: $4016 Controller strobe (write) and controller 1 data (read).

name: Ctrl2FrameCtr
summary: $4017 Controller 2 data (read); APU frame counter (write).

name: SaveRamBegin
summary: $6001 $5A once save RAM is initialized (with SaveRamEnd = $A5).

name: SaveFileAName0
summary: $6002 [8] File A, slot 0: name. (The SaveFileA* blocks are addressed through

name: SaveFileAName1
summary: $600A [8] File A, slot 1: name.

name: SaveFileAName2
summary: $6012 [8] File A, slot 2: name.

name: SaveFileAItems0
summary: $601A [40] File A, slot 0: copy of the items block InvItems ($657-$67E).

name: SaveFileAItems1
summary: $6042 [40] File A, slot 1: items block.

name: SaveFileAItems2
summary: $606A [40] File A, slot 2: items block.

name: SaveFileAWorldFlags0
summary: $6092 [384] File A, slot 0: copy of WorldFlags ($67F-$7FE).

name: SaveFileAWorldFlags1
summary: $6212 [384] File A, slot 1: world flags.

name: SaveFileAWorldFlags2
summary: $6392 [384] File A, slot 2: world flags.

name: SaveFileASlotActive0
summary: $6512 File A, slot 0: nonzero = slot registered (source of IsSaveSlotActive).

name: SaveFileASlotActive1
summary: $6513 File A, slot 1: slot registered.

name: SaveFileASlotActive2
summary: $6514 File A, slot 2: slot registered.

name: SaveFileADeathCount0
summary: $6515 File A, slot 0: death count (source of DeathCounts).

name: SaveFileADeathCount1
summary: $6516 File A, slot 1: death count.

name: SaveFileADeathCount2
summary: $6517 File A, slot 2: death count.

name: SaveFileAQuestNumber0
summary: $651B File A, slot 0: quest, 0 = Q1, 1 = Q2 (source of QuestNumbers).

name: SaveFileAQuestNumber1
summary: $651C File A, slot 1: quest.

name: SaveFileAQuestNumber2
summary: $651D File A, slot 2: quest.

name: SaveFileOpenMarkers
summary: $651E [3] per slot: $5A while file A is whole; 0 during the B-to-A copy.

name: SaveFileCloseMarkers
summary: $6521 [3] per slot: $A5 while file A is whole; 0 during the B-to-A copy.

name: SaveFileAChecksums
summary: $6524 [3] x 2 bytes: file A checksum per slot; a mismatch reformats the slot.

name: IsSaveFileBCommitted
summary: $652A [3] per slot: $FF = file B fully copied to file A; 0 = copy pending.

name: PlayAreaTiles
summary: $6530 [704] Play area tile map: 32 columns x 22 rows, stored by column.

name: LevelBlockAttrsA
summary: $687E [128] Dungeon: bits 7-5 N door type, 4-2 S door type, 1-0 outer palette.

name: LevelBlockAttrsB
summary: $68FE [128] Dungeon: bits 7-5 W door type, 4-2 E door type, 1-0 inner palette.

name: LevelBlockAttrsC
summary: $697E [128] Bits 7-6 index into LevelInfo_FoeCounts, 5-0 monster list id.

name: LevelBlockAttrsD
summary: $69FE [128] Bit 7 = bit 6 of the monster list id, bit 6 push block (dungeon),

name: LevelBlockAttrsE
summary: $6A7E [128] Dungeon: bit 7 dark room, 6-5 boss roar index, 4-0 room item id

name: LevelBlockAttrsF
summary: $6AFE [128] Bits 5-4 index into LevelInfo_ShortcutOrItemPosArray.

name: LevelInfo_PalettesTransferBuf
summary: $6B7E [36] PPU transfer record with the level's palettes.

name: LevelInfo_FoeCounts
summary: $6BA2 [4] Monster counts selectable by attr C bits 7-6 (dungeons: 3, 5, 6, 8).

name: LevelInfo_StartY
summary: $6BA6 Link's Y when the level is entered ($DD in dungeons, $8D overworld).

name: LevelInfo_ShortcutOrItemPosArray
summary: $6BA7 [4] Positions: high nibble X, low nibble Y (each * $10).

name: LevelInfo_SubmenuMapRotation
summary: $6BAB Columns the submenu map is rotated to match the level's shape.

name: LevelInfo_StatusBarMapXOffset
summary: $6BAC Pixels added to the status bar position marker's X.

name: LevelInfo_StartRoomId
summary: $6BAD Room where Link starts the level.

name: LevelInfo_TriforceRoomId
summary: $6BAE Room marked by the compass (Triforce marker on the status bar map).

name: LevelInfo_WorldFlagsAddr
summary: $6BAF 2 bytes lo/hi: address of this level's 128 bytes in WorldFlags.

name: LevelInfo_LevelNumber
summary: $6BB1 Level number 1-9 for the "LEVEL-n" text; 0 = overworld.

name: LevelInfo_CellarRoomIdArray
summary: $6BB2 [10] Dungeon: room ids of the cellars, $FF-padded.

name: LevelInfo_BossRoomId
summary: $6BBC Boss room; while its kills flag is not "all dead" rooms play the roar.

name: LevelInfo_SubmenuMapMask
summary: $6BBD [16] per map column: bit set = a room exists in that row.

name: LevelInfo_StatusBarMapTransferBuf
summary: $6BCD [45] PPU transfer record of the status bar map.

name: LevelInfo_PaletteCycles
summary: $6BFA [96] Fade series: 8-byte palette halves, indexed through FadeCycle.

name: LevelInfo_DeathPaletteSeries
summary: $6C5A [32] Fade series $60 (death): 4 steps of 8 bytes.

name: SaveRamEnd
summary: $7FFF $A5 once save RAM is initialized; see SaveRamBegin.
